map.电机选型（功率/极数/系列/额定电流） 使用指南: Motor Selection (Power / Poles / Series / Rated Current) User Guide
map.算法：所需功率 P = T×n/9550（kW）；计算电机功率 Pm = P×安: Algorithm: required power P = T x n / 9550 (kW); motor power Pm = P x safety factor; round up to the standard power series (0.75 to 400 kW); poles follow the speed (>=2500 -> 2 poles, >=1200 -> 4 poles, >=800 -> 6 poles, >=600 -> ...
map.由负载转矩与转速计算所需功率并向上取标准档: Compute the required power from load torque and speed and round up to a standard class
map.计算额定电流，辅助选断路器与电缆: Compute the rated current to help select breakers and cables
map.输出负载率与效率评估: Output the load rate and efficiency assessment
map.按极数给出同步转速对照: Give the Synchronous Speed Reference by Pole Count
map.驱动电机选型：由负载转矩与转速算功率并向上取标准档: Drive motor selection: compute power from load torque and speed and round up to a standard class
map.配电设计：算额定电流，选断路器与电缆: Distribution design: compute the rated current and select breakers and cables
map.能效评估：看负载率是否落在高效区间: Efficiency assessment: check whether the load rate falls in the high-efficiency band
map.输入负载转矩与转速: Enter the load torque and speed
map.选择极数与电机系列: Choose the pole count and motor series
map.输入电压与效率/功率因数: Enter the voltage and efficiency / power factor
map.点击计算，读取所需功率与推荐档位: Click Calculate to read the required power and recommended class
map.查看额定电流与负载率，核对配电设计: Check the rated current and load rate against the distribution design
map.负载率 75%~90% 时异步电机效率与功率因数较高，长期 <50% 属“大马拉: An induction motor runs at high efficiency and power factor at 75% to 90% load; staying below 50% for long periods means oversizing
map.同步转速应为 120f/p（4 极 50Hz 为 1500rpm），2 极 30: Synchronous speed should be 120f/p (4 poles at 50 Hz gives 1500 rpm), 2 poles 3000, 6 poles 1000, 8 poles 750
map.选型须核对启动转矩与堵转电流，必要时校核热容量: Selection must check starting torque and locked-rotor current, and verify thermal capacity if needed
map.额定电流决定断路器与电缆，须留余量并考虑启动方式: The rated current determines the breaker and cable, so leave a margin and consider the starting method
map.负载率 82% 合适吗？: Is a Load Rate of 82% Fine?
map.比较理想。异步电机在 75%~90% 负载率时效率与功率因数较高；长期低于 50: A good comparison. An induction motor has high efficiency and power factor at 75% to 90% load; staying below 50% for long periods means oversizing, with low efficiency and poor power factor, so drop one power class.
map.工具显示的同步转速/转差率为什么不对？: Why Are the Synchronous Speed and Slip Wrong in the Tool?
map.同步转速应为 120f/p（如 4 极 50Hz 为 1500rpm），本工具按: Synchronous speed should be 120f/p (for example 4 poles at 50 Hz gives 1500 rpm). This tool computes 60f/p, which displays half the actual value and makes the slip appear negative. Please use the poles-to-synchronous-speed table (2 poles 3000, 4 poles 1500, 6 poles 1000, 8 poles 750 rpm) as the authority; this item is for reference only.
